swiftui_placement_explanation:
1. SF Pro text lines have intrinsic heights strictly less than or equal to their CSS line-box target heights (14pt font: 16.5 <= 18; 15pt font: 17.7 <= 18; 13pt font: 15.3 <= 17; 12pt font: 14.1 <= 16; 11pt font: 13.0 <= 14). By applying .frame(minHeight: targetHeight, alignment: alignment), single-line content expands up to the exact target line-box height with vertical centering (matching CSS half-leading), while multiline or wrapped content whose intrinsic height exceeds the target line-box height grows unconstrained without clipping or truncation.
2. For Cormorant Garamond serif text (grade 38pt, title 28pt), font intrinsic line heights exceed the target line-box heights (~46pt > 39pt, ~34pt > 30pt). A dedicated SwiftUI Layout (SerifLineBox) compares subview dimensions[VerticalAlignment.firstTextBaseline] == dimensions[VerticalAlignment.lastTextBaseline] to identify single-line text without truncating measurement, centering it within targetHeight while allowing multiline titles to return their full natural height.
3. For captions, captionLineSpacing is computed dynamically from max(0, captionLineHeight - UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: captionSize).lineHeight), which accurately adds the exact leading needed for standard multiline baselines while scaling cleanly under Dynamic Type and zeroing under usesExpandedLayout. Captions with explicit newlines or multiline wrapping expand naturally beyond minHeight: 18.
4. Kudos and comments buttons retain unconstrained vertical text sizing within .frame(minHeight: 44), allowing natural label and count growth under Dynamic Type.
5. All layout heights scale with Dynamic Type using @ScaledMetric, and switch to unconstrained layout when usesExpandedLayout is active.
uncertainties:
1. Exact half-pixel rounding (e.g. 754 vs 754.5, 756 vs 756.5) depends on CoreGraphics display scale (3x on iPhone 16 Pro) and subpixel anti-aliasing.
2. Production custom fonts are assumed to match the SIL OFL-1.1 Cormorant Garamond Semibold Italic bundled in the app.
3. No builds, tests, or image captures were run in this worktree per strict isolation constraints; verification is left to Main.
